content.title: Readiness Reversal | Apparent Vulnerability, Displacement, Goal Resume
content.summary: Present one centered adult as vulnerable, let attackers enter range, reveal a small readiness cue, and return the adult to the original goal after reversal.

quick_start.input_format: The protagonist appears vulnerable and remains centered. + Attackers visibly enter close range. + A small readiness cue precedes the reversal. + Fast displacements preserve one geographic axis. + The subject returns to the baseline and resumes the original goal.
quick_start.recommended_input: Center an adult emergency courier in a flooded transit plaza while three raiders close from both sides. The courier redirects that body into a fixed ticket barrier with one grounded pivot. Let spray settle and return the courier to the original center line before resuming the delivery route.
